messages:
infra-bot: INCIDENT detected - multiple model fetch failures from huggingface.co for model urn:hf/redwood/large-v2 (5xx / rate-limited responses). auto-escalation to #incidents triggered. link: https://status.huggingface.co/incident/xyz :warning:
sophie (oncall): seeing increased 5xx on model fetch path, cold-start failures spiking. customers getting 502s on /v1/generate when runtime tries to pull weights. paging ben and jamie. :pager:
jamie (runtime): confirmed. logs show 429/502 from hf S3-backed registry during parallel pulls. affected: new container cold starts only (cache miss). warm instances serve ok.
jamie (runtime): stacktrace snippet:```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z runtime fetcher: GET https://huggingface.co/api/models/redwood/large-v2/resolve -> 429
fetcher/backoff.go:45: transient error, retrying x3
```
ben (eng-sre): likely HF rate limiting on their artifact CDN after a burst of prefetches. we've hit concurrent pull limit for region us-west-2. adding temp mitigation: reduce parallelism and enable exponential backoff in fetcher. applying policy change to replication pool.
carla (support): we have 2 paying customers reporting errors (tenant-a, tenant-b). impact: new sessions fail 20% of the time, older sessions OK. notifying those accounts now.
sophie (oncall): assign severity — I'd call this Sev2 due to partial customer impact and ongoing customer reports. starting incident doc. tagging customer-impact: partial.
ben (eng-sre): mitigation plan (short):
- enable client-side exponential backoff + jitter (already rolling out)
- throttle concurrent downloads from hf to 2 per host
- fall back to cached quantized variant if primary model fetch fails
- trigger pre-warm for high-traffic tenants only
rolling changes to fetcher config via infra feature flag: `hf_fetch.parallelism=2`
jamie (runtime): rollout command I'm running now:```
kubectl set env deploy/runtime-fetcher HF_FETCH_PARALLELISM=2 --namespace=prod || true
# patch to enable backoff behavior pushed to canary first
```
infra-bot: deploy triggered: runtime-fetcher v1.8.2-canary -> canary accepted, rolling to 5% nodes.
jamie (runtime): can we route retries to a mirror registry? we have an s3 mirror in us-west-2 (internal-mirror.redwood). I'll open a quick feature toggle to prefer mirror on persistent 429s.
ben (eng-sre): yes, toggle `fetch.prefer_mirror=true` on canary only. if mirror responds OK, we'll promote. Also adding header-based queuing to reduce HF burst.
sophie (oncall): Carla, please update tenant-a and tenant-b with status and suggested workaround (retries or temporary model pin to cached quantized variant). make sure CS escalation is ready.
carla (support): message sent to tenant-a and tenant-b. suggested workaround included: set model to `redwood/large-v2-quant` (cached), and increase client retry to 5s. awaiting responses.
jamie (runtime): canary metrics look better after decreasing parallelism + mirror toggle. error rate back to baseline for canary. promoting to 25% while monitoring.
ben (eng-sre): adding a short-term quota on our side to smooth cluster churn. also filed an API support ticket with Hugging Face describing the rate spikes and requesting temporary quota lift (ticket #HF-45321).
sophie (oncall): any impact to Dedicated customers / Private deployments?
jamie (runtime): Private deployments unaffected (they host artifacts locally). Dedicated customers with prewarmed pools fine. only self-serve hosted where cold-starts hit HF.
sophie (oncall): handoff — I'm taking a break at 15:30 UTC, handing to ben for next 2 hours. ben you ok to take pager? :coffee:
ben (eng-sre): oncall handover ack. I'll keep monitoring, will escalate to SRE if mirror fails.
pagerduty-bot: PAge: ben (eng-sre) assigned to incident INC-2026-045. Reminder: next oncall rotation at 17:00 UTC.
ben (eng-sre): next steps for postmortem prep: collect fetcher logs, HF ticket updates, timing of deploys, list impacted tenants + error counts. we'll capture root cause: third-party rate-limit + high parallel cold-start behavior.
sophie (oncall): closing initial loop — temporary mitigations in place (parallelism throttles, backoff, mirror fallback). severity remains 2, customer impact limited and being communicated. handing off to ben.
carla (support): will follow up with customers and update incident doc with any replies.
ben (eng-sre): will keep thread updated and post final resolution when HF confirms ticket or our permanent mitigations shipped. :white_check_mark:
